note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Near-term odds eased this sweep: 82% by Jul 31 (from ~90%), 37% by Jul 24 (from 68%), 94% by Aug 31, 99% by Dec 31. Fits Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence; exact version unannounced.

Jul 21 Google shipped three Flash models but reconfirmed 3.5 Pro is still in partner testing — a fourth missed target, citing internal performance goals. Markets lean early August after it missed Google's own quality bar.
Polymarket holds ~87% by Dec 31 (71% by Sep 30, <1% by Jul 31). OpenAI's near-term line still runs through GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) and GPT-Live voice.
V4-Pro/Flash have been open-weight previews since Apr 24. Trackers cite a Jul 24 'stable release,' also the deepseek-chat/reasoner API-alias retirement date — no confirmed GA and no dated market.
xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term (~16% before Sep). The 6T V9-foundation model reportedly still training on Colossus 2.
Google reportedly began Gemini 4 pre-training while flagship 3.5 Pro is still in partner testing; no date and no market.
